mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID=#{dmId} AND USE_YN='Y') AS totalObj, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID=#{dmId} AND USE_YN='Y' AND COALESCE(STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N') AS objStndOff, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID=#{dmId} AND USE_YN='Y' AND COALESCE(STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N') AS objStructOff, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID=#{dmId} AND USE_YN='Y' AND COALESCE(QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N') AS objQualOff, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_ID=#{dmId} AND USE_YN='Y') AS totalAttr, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR a INNER JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ o ON a.DM_ID=o.DM_ID AND a.OBJ_NM=o.OBJ_NM WHERE a.DM_ID=#{dmId} AND a.USE_YN='Y' AND o.USE_YN='Y' AND (COALESCE(a.STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N' OR COALESCE(o.STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N')) AS attrStndOff, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR a INNER JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ o ON a.DM_ID=o.DM_ID AND a.OBJ_NM=o.OBJ_NM WHERE a.DM_ID=#{dmId} AND a.USE_YN='Y' AND o.USE_YN='Y' AND (COALESCE(a.STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N' OR COALESCE(o.STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N')) AS attrStructOff, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR a INNER JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ o ON a.DM_ID=o.DM_ID AND a.OBJ_NM=o.OBJ_NM WHERE a.DM_ID=#{dmId} AND a.USE_YN='Y' AND o.USE_YN='Y' AND (COALESCE(a.QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N' OR COALESCE(o.QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y')='N')) AS attrQualOff

SELECT OBJ_OWNER AS "objOwner" ,OBJ_NM AS "objNm" ,OBJ_NM_KR AS "objNmKr" ,OBJ_ATTR_CNT AS "attrCnt" ,COALESCE(STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') AS "stndDiagTargetYn" ,STND_DIAG_TARGET_REASON AS "stndDiagTargetReason" ,COALESCE(STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') AS "structDiagTargetYn" ,STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_REASON AS "structDiagTargetReason" ,COALESCE(QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') AS "qualDiagTargetYn" ,QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_REASON AS "qualDiagTargetReason" ,DIAG_TARGET_UPDT_USER_ID AS "diagTargetUpdtUserId" ,to_char(to_timestamp(DIAG_TARGET_UPDT_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "diagTargetUpdtDt" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_OWNER = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
